response.sql: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq WHERE avg_hum IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, overall.overall_avg FROM eq, overall WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM above) SELECT a.equipref AS equipment_reference, a.avg_hum AS average_humidity, a.avg_hum - a.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_average, a.avg_hum - g.group_avg AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above a, grp g WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (a.avg_hum - g.group_avg) IS NULL, (a.avg_hum - g.group_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
